posts.title: Scraping our friends back
posts.description: I too want the internet to be better. I want this for altruistic reasons, as I think the internet offers a unique and important value to society, but also selfish ones. The internet's my home, where my friends and family are, where I do activities I care about, and build things for the future. It's been a rough go for the internet though.
